advanced-strength-cream.title: Advanced Strength Cream
advanced-strength-cream.descriptionHtml_before:
Advanced is the higher-strength Comfort Cream, for regular aesthetic work.

Formulated for longer or more sensitive sessions. No tier is better than another; each suits a different kind of session. If your appointments are routine and short, Clinical is the tier to start from — match it to the session you're actually having, not to price.
